name: position_observe
description: CoAP Observe notification PAYLOAD sequences for position tracking (spec 12-apps.md section 18.2.3 Position Subscribe). Each vector drives the real stack end to end: SenMLLocationResource mounted via build_site on InMemoryNetwork, client subscribes with Observe: 0, then resource.update() pushes one notification per fix. Payloads are SenML+CBOR packs (Content-Format 112) built by lichen.senml.codec.pack from profiles.location records, which carry no timestamps and are therefore byte-deterministic. coap_observe_sequence.json separately pins Observe option sequence arithmetic; this family pins the notification bodies. No rejection path exists (profiles.location validates its own inputs, covered by senml_location.json error vectors).

vectors.name: location_observe_tracking_sequence
vectors.description: Blue-force-tracking session: initial response is the empty pack (resource constructed without a fix), then three movement notifications - SF fix, SF fix with altitude 32.5 m, then a distant Vienna fix without altitude.

vectors.name: location_observe_altitude_transition
vectors.description: Altitude appearing then disappearing: same lat/lon fix first with alt 10.5 m, then without - each transition notifies observers even though coordinates are unchanged.
